content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to use the integrated display on [product_name] as a touch screen? For instance, can a SWITCH be created on the display to operate a valve? If anyone has information, please share your advice. Thanks. Best Regards, [user_name]
The display only provides function and cursor keys. You may want to check the examples page at [url] for reference material. Best Regards,
Hello [user_name], Thanks for your response. I plan to use the integrated display, not the external operator device. Thanks. Best Regards, [user_name]
You can use the cursor keys for interaction. See the attached image for guidance. To control the valve, press 'esc' simultaneously with a cursor key. Best Regards,
Hello [user_name], Thank you very much. If possible, could you please share the program file related to the valve (jpg attachment)? Thanks. Best Regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], The requested file is attached. Best regards,

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to utilize the integrated display on a [product_name] for touch screen-like control, such as activating a valve via a virtual switch. Responses clarify that the display is only equipped with physical function and cursor keys, not with touch functionality. Alternatives like pressing key combinations are suggested, emphasizing the limitation and difference from expected touch capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated that the integrated display on [product_name] might have touch screen abilities or support the creation of interactive virtual switch controls directly on the display.
